verdict.rationale: The only mandatory-online filing, the annual report and franchise tax, uses a keyless entry: a Business Entity File Number plus an image CAPTCHA, with an optional saved session ID. A human can complete this remotely, and the evidence shows no biometric liveness, in-person visit or mailed PIN. However, it is not a credential-based MFA sign-in, so it only partly matches the story. Missing for 10: a documented account or credential login with MFA, and any hands-on confirmation of completing the flow.
